handback.summary: The install file now hands Dokima the Codex and Kimi keys by name, so the audit receives them.

criteria.907.1: Each adapter reads its own error; `agents.rejected_key` matches a refusal and the record marks the run Model key rejected.
criteria.907.2: The record names the secret `agents.adapter` reads from the settings for that role.
criteria.907.3: `rejected_key_line` says the provider refused the key: make a new one and replace the repo secret.
criteria.907.4: The card shows only the fixed line, never the provider's words, so no key part is printed.
criteria.907.5: `audit.compare_keys` tries each set key once via `agents.try_key`; `audit.yml` installs the agents first.
criteria.907.6: A refused key adds one audit line naming only its secret.
criteria.907.7: A key with no `DOKIMA_KEY_<name>` value is skipped; no agent starts.
criteria.907.8: `dokima/install/dokima.yml` maps all three keys by name; `entry.yml` passes them; `audit.yml` sets `DOKIMA_KEY_<name>`.
criteria.907.9: Audit lines hold only secret names; the agent's own error output is silenced during the try.

handback.evidence: `pytest -q tests/test_key_rejected.py tests/test_secrets_by_name.py` and install tests: 63 passed
